why_ai: Boards and CEOs pay for a specific partner's judgement and relationships on consequential hiring decisions with slow feedback, though the research beneath it automates.
why_clarity: Every search is a new brief, assessment is done by feel, and whether a placement worked is known only years later.
why_digital: Research and reporting run on screens, but candidate meetings, board presentations and winning mandates run on in-person relationships.

why_ai: Clients buy a named partner's access and assessment for the most consequential hires a company makes.
why_clarity: Each C-suite brief differs, partners assess differently, and success shows only over years in role.
why_digital: Mapping and reporting are digital; interviews, client meetings and closing are largely in person.

why_ai: Boards pay for a trusted adviser's judgement on insiders versus outsiders, a novel, high-stakes decision made rarely.
why_clarity: There is no agreed method for comparing insiders with the market, and the outcome is known years later.
why_digital: Benchmarks are built on screen, but assessment interviews and board sessions are conducted in person.

why_ai: Mapping a known functional pool automates, while assessment and persuasion still rest on the partner.
why_clarity: The pool and the brief are well defined and recur, though fit is judged and outcomes arrive slowly.
why_digital: Maps, compensation data and slates are digital; final interviews and closing are partly in person.

why_ai: Sponsors pay for partners who know which operators deliver plans, a judgement tested by exits.
why_clarity: Roles recur across portfolios and success is concrete, but each company and plan differs.
why_digital: Research and assessment are mostly remote; sponsor and candidate relationships are built face to face.

why_ai: Nominating committees pay for a board practice partner's network and discretion; the relationship is the product.
why_clarity: Board needs are idiosyncratic and a director's contribution is never measured objectively.
why_digital: Screening uses data, but approaching directors and presenting to committees is personal and in person.

why_ai: Committees pay for a facilitator who can hold many constituencies to one decision, with campus visits in person.
why_clarity: The process is codified, but committee consensus and leadership fit are matters of judgement.
why_digital: Dossiers are digital, but listening sessions, committee meetings and finalist visits happen on campus.

why_ai: Integration support rests on trusted conversations with a new executive and their CEO about novel situations.
why_clarity: Every integration differs and whether support helped is unclear even when the executive stays.
why_digital: Check-ins can be remote, but coaching and stakeholder conversations are often in person.

why_ai: Supplying a boutique's missing research bench is screen work that AI tools and outsourcers increasingly do.
why_clarity: The research deliverable is a defined map and longlist, repeated per search and checkable on the first call.
why_digital: Archives, data and tools in; maps and longlists out, bought online by small firms.

why_ai: Identifying and levelling role holders from filings and profiles is retrieval and extraction AI does well.
why_clarity: A map is complete or not and each person holds the role or not, repeated on every search.
why_digital: Public and licensed data in, a digital map and longlist out.

why_ai: Applying client terms and privacy deadlines to resolved entities is rule automation, with counsel accountable for policy.
why_clarity: A name is callable or not under written terms and dated legal obligations.
why_digital: Records, contracts and notices are entirely digital.

why_ai: Mapping and candidate research are automatable, though the archive of interviews and placements is hard to rebuild.
why_clarity: Market maps and longlists recur in the same shape across thousands of mandates and are checked on contact.
why_digital: Filings, profiles and the firm's CRM in, digital research packs out, often from offshore centres.

why_ai: Boards trust named assessors, sometimes licensed psychologists, with judgements about their top executives.
why_clarity: Frameworks are written, but ratings vary by assessor and predictive validity is rarely checked.
why_digital: Psychometrics are online, while interviews, simulations and board feedback are often in person.

why_ai: Chairs choose a trusted, independent reviewer to hear directors' candid views; the relationship is the product.
why_clarity: Questionnaires are standard, but the diagnosis is judgement and its effect on board performance is unmeasured.
why_digital: Director interviews and meeting observation are partly in person; the report is digital.

why_ai: Compiling profiles from public filings and announcements is extraction and change detection AI automates.
why_clarity: A profile's current role and history are either correct or not, maintained to a fixed standard.
why_digital: Public sources in, a subscription database out.

why_ai: Extracting and standardising proxy pay tables is document AI work on public filings.
why_clarity: Disclosed figures are exact and the extraction can be checked line by line.
why_digital: Filings in, datasets and benchmark tools out, sold online.

why_ai: Counting departures and appointments from public filings is easily automated and replicated.
why_clarity: Annual indices follow fixed counting rules, checkable against filings.
why_digital: Filings and announcements in, digital reports out.

why_ai: Only a supervisor can approve or condition a bank director's appointment, and it carries the accountability.
why_clarity: Criteria are codified in guidelines and cases recur, but suitability is judged and consequences surface later.
why_digital: Questionnaires and files are digital, with interviews and decisions bound to each jurisdiction.

why_ai: Sponsors rely on a talent partner's judgement of operators on high-stakes portfolio leadership calls.
why_clarity: Each portfolio situation is different and leadership calls are judged at exit, years later.
why_digital: Analysis is on screen, but assessing and placing executives runs on in-person relationships.

why_ai: Unbundled name generation and mapping is the work AI sourcing tools substitute most directly.
why_clarity: Each project delivers a defined list or map, repeated across clients.
why_digital: Briefs in, lists and org charts out, delivered remotely, often offshore.

why_ai: Product research and customer surveys from telemetry are screen work AI does well.
why_clarity: Research questions change each release, with usage metrics as feedback.
why_digital: Telemetry and surveys in, internal reports out.

why_ai: The coach's relationship with a new executive is the product, through novel and sensitive situations.
why_clarity: Coaching methods vary by coach and impact is hard to separate from everything else in the role.
why_digital: Sessions run remotely or in person; buying is through referrals and relationships.

why_ai: Acquisition decisions are high-stakes and negotiated, but the internal team carries no licence.
why_clarity: Each deal is unique and its success, chiefly partner retention, is known years later.
why_digital: Theses and models built on screen; deals negotiated through relationships.

why_ai: Member surveys and rankings are easy to produce, but the association's convening and standards role persists.
why_clarity: Annual surveys repeat; their quality and rankings' accuracy have no quick objective check.
why_digital: Surveys and articles are digital, with conferences delivered in person.
